title: Courtyard replanting for a Fernwood strata

seo.title: Sample project: Fernwood strata courtyard | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: a shaded strata courtyard in Fernwood, Victoria, replanted with shade-tolerant natives and new edging, phased around residents. Free quote.

summary: A shaded courtyard with failing shrubs replanted with shade-tolerant natives.
story: Half the courtyard shrubs had died and owners disagreed about what to plant.
We gave council two planting options with a plant list for each. Work was done in halves so residents always had a clear path to their doors.
Read more about [landscape installation](/services/landscape-installation/), see our work in [Victoria](/areas/victoria/), or [get a free quote](/quote/).
result: Council chose a plan from written options, and residents kept access throughout.
